# Encoded-header safety corpus

Each pair retains ordinary core headers plus X-Project and a later X-Later field. The unchanged creator does not render these extra fields. A valid encoded value, malformed base64 length/alphabet/padding, malformed Q escape and optional source omission have independently declared outcomes in cases.json.

The recipe optionally adds Mail_X-Project to the first message's effective UserProperties. Valid decoded fidelity passes, malformed decoded fidelity stays unavailable WARN, and omitted isolated originals give N/A. The source-only malformed case has no such property: inspecting an unrelated bad header must not abort the whole validator. Every non-isolated case still has ten equal observed core fields and both later source fields; the isolated case retains ten observations with unavailable source comparisons.

All six files must pass independent PDF/A and mandatory EA-PDF. Malformed optional source encodings do not create a new normative PDF failure. Source bytes/hashes and raw parsed payloads remain exact. Full contextual RFC 2047 syntax/placement, original eight-bit header interpretation, header aggregation and rendered-header coverage remain outside this bounded repair.
